programmes.d: A notorious gang of marauders known as The Dog Soldiers swears vengeance against Matt Dillon for the execution of one of their members.
Outlaws threaten to use Kitty and Doc as hostages.
Marshal Dillon returns to Dodge City with a dangerous prisoner. No sooner than he gets his prisoner locked up, he encounters a runaway boy with larceny on his mind.
An outlaw gang terrorizes Dodge City.
Matt Dillon learns that the man who taught him everything he knows is now an itinerant drunk. Dillon deputizes Adam Kimbrough in the hopes of rehabilitating him.
A Quaker colony tries to save the giant sequoias from a timber baron.
Several settlers and travelers are taken captive by a band of renegade Indians and sold to white mercenaries for slave labor and prostitution.

Marshal Dillon rescues Stella and Marcy, now a motherless child, from their Indian captor, and they accompany the Marshal as he tries to stop white slave trader Fitzpatrick from escaping to Mexico with his potential slaves.
A wounded Matt Dillon loses his memory and falls in love with an attractive widow.

Ron Moody, an Oscar nominee for his role in the movie Oliver, guest stars as a man torn between keeping his own self-respect and the friendship of a young boy and keeping his drunken promise to help two hired gunmen.
Steve Forrest guest stars as a gunfighter whose speed is legendary but who now is trying to live a quiet, nonviolent life with Teresa, the girl he loves.

James Stacy guest stars as a personable thief, who doesn't relish the thought of a minimum two-year sentence because of his past record and, therefore, seeks to escape from Festus en route to the Dodge City jail.
Morgan Woodward plays Bear Sanderson, a man who seeks his own revenge when outlaw Indians kill his wife and bum his home.
Newly's skill with both people and medicine is put to the test when Doc sends him out to check on families in the back country

A retarded young man becomes the ward of Festus. A young man named Billy arrives in Dodge to visit his best friend, Festus. When the teenager, who has no family and is retarded, attacks and injures a drover for tormenting a cat, he is arrested.
Sam Groom and Sandra Morgan play a fugitive and his Indian wife who frustrate Newly by seeking medical help for their baby and then refusing to take his advice
A daring jailbreak reunites a family of vicious outlaws who wound a pursuing U.S. marshal, kid his deputy, then wait in ambush for the injured lawman and Marshal Dillon.
Matt and a fellow marshal are ordered to quiet down a lawless town
A homeless baby triggers the mother instinct in two women, one of whom is Kitty.
A threatening range war brings a mercenary gunman to Dodge City.
A widower tries to protect the reputation of his son's teacher, and faces a charge of murder because of it.
Craig Stevens, Kurt Russell and Tom Simcox are guest stars in the story of a farm youth's grim track down of the man who killed his father.
The residents of Dodge City are stunned when Matt Dillon feels he can no longer keep law and order and turns in his marshal's badge.
